title: Add [windows.xbox] spec tree to vendor SSOT (preferences/start/xbox/features/drivers/guest_tools/components/settings/users-by-ref/vm/debloat); centered taskbar, search hidden, Start row exactly Personal,Network,Explorer,Settings; bridge configurator autounattend.* keys

acceptance.positive: mios-toml-get windows.xbox.preferences.taskbar_align = 1 through load_merged; mios-ssot-lint green
acceptance.negative: a user-layer override taskbar_align=0 is reported as off-spec by xb-03

risk: medium; operator answers Q1-Q8 change values; touches the vendor SSOT (write atomically)

title: Renderer: load_merged SSOT -> resolved xbox-spec.json (single input to every Windows step); missing key or empty credential = hard fail

acceptance.positive: rendered json equals the vendor->host->user merge for all keys
acceptance.negative: deleting taskbar_align or blanking a password makes the render exit non-zero

risk: low

title: Offline spec-conformance gate (rendered inputs + offline image inspection), with legacy-literal deny-list

acceptance.positive: gate green on fixtures rendered from the SSOT
acceptance.negative: planted TaskbarAl=0, SearchboxTaskbarMode=1, Start_ShowDownloads=1, an nvidia .inf in the driver set, or the literal 'mios' password each fail with a named finding

risk: low

title: Pins gate for the Windows pipeline: reject version/build/URL pins in [windows.xbox] and the pipeline code (stable-virtio, fixed UUP build, LG commit match)

acceptance.positive: green on HEAD after xb-06
acceptance.negative: planting virtio_url=.../stable-virtio/ or uup_build=29683.1000 fails

risk: low

title: Port the Windows pipeline into MiOS code (UUP fetch/convert, DISM servicing, answer-file emit, ISO) reading only xbox-spec.json; delete Set-MiOSCustomDefaults, the NTLite presets, the duplicate unattend_gen paths and every TaskbarAl/Searchbox/Start literal

acceptance.positive: xb-03 green on the rendered answer file and SetupComplete payload
acceptance.negative: grep gate finds no TaskbarAl literal outside the renderer; reinserting the legacy UserOnce block fails xb-03

risk: high; large port; must rebase on the mios-ssot-credentials changes

title: Latest-resolvers: UUP Dump newest build for the edition's channel, virtio-win latest-virtio, qemu-ga latest, Looking Glass host stable, WinFsp, WebView2; write build-manifest.json only

acceptance.positive: manifest lists resolved versions + sha256; nothing written back to the SSOT
acceptance.negative: resolver failure aborts the build (no cached fallback to a pinned version)

risk: medium; upstream endpoints change

title: Xbox features + Windows features + debloat from SSOT: FSE overrides, DeviceForm, GamingHomeApp/StartupToGamingHome, Game Mode/Game Bar/Auto HDR, HAGS, optional-feature enable/disable list; consume debloat_profile, drop posture

acceptance.positive: offline hive inspection shows each SSOT value
acceptance.negative: an SSOT feature removed from the image is reported missing by xb-03

risk: medium; feature IDs vary by build family

title: Bake drivers and guest tools: virtio-win (install.wim + boot.wim), virtio-win-guest-tools (qemu-ga, SPICE vdagent), VirtIO-FS + WinFsp, Looking Glass host + IDD (installed at SetupComplete); remove gpu_drivers_dir/-ForceUnsigned

acceptance.positive: wimlib driver-store listing contains viostor/netkvm/vioscsi/viofs/balloon; payload has qemu-ga, vdagent, LG host+IDD
acceptance.negative: an NVIDIA/AMD/Intel display .inf in the payload fails xb-03

risk: medium

title: Guest GPU post-setup step: detect PCI vendor/device IDs -> vendor upstream latest driver, Authenticode verify, install, record version; no-op for an absent vendor

acceptance.positive: mocked 10de:2684 resolves the latest NVIDIA package and verifies its signature
acceptance.negative: no supported GPU -> installs nothing; a tampered signature aborts

risk: high; NVIDIA resolver API is unofficial

title: Stage MiOS componentry from build output (native exes incl. mios-wallpaperd, miosd, agent-relay, MiosServiceTool, FhsSync, ssh/oscontrol/LG scripts per [windows.xbox.components]); replace legacy C# wallpaper blobs and jpg

acceptance.positive: offline image has every listed component with the expected hash plus its scheduled task/service
acceptance.negative: removing one component from the payload fails xb-03

risk: medium; native Windows build must be current

title: Capture start2.bin and VisiblePlaces for the target build family on the worker; store them as SSOT-referenced assets with a build-family key

acceptance.positive: applied blob gives an empty grid and the 4 folders in the probe
acceptance.negative: family mismatch between asset and image fails xb-03

risk: medium; blobs are opaque and per build

title: Users and credentials from merged SSOT in answer file and provision; remove every hard-coded fallback; RID-500 re-secure at finalize

acceptance.positive: rendered answer-file accounts/autologon equal the SSOT (compared as hashes, never printed)
acceptance.negative: empty SSOT password aborts the render; planted literal fallback fails xb-03

risk: medium; overlaps the credentials workflow, must wait

title: VM domain generator from [vm.win11]/[vm.looking_glass]: q35, secboot OVMF + swtpm, Hyper-V enlightenments, virtio disk/net/video, qemu-ga channel, SPICE 5930 + VNC, dGPU 01:00.0/.1, IVSHMEM 128M; domains list puts mios-xbox first; stage the ISO into a pool; add virt-viewer to [packages.virt]

acceptance.positive: generated XML validates with virt-xml-validate and matches the SSOT fields
acceptance.negative: rtl8139/SATA/no-TPM/port-5900 planted in the SSOT fails the test

title: Define the GPU-less build worker mios-xbox-worker on a qcow2 overlay of the mios-xbox-current disk (original domain/disk untouched); attach worker-tools and virtio ISOs

acceptance.positive: worker boots without a hostdev, WinRM reachable, DISM/oscdimg present

acceptance.negative: launch refuses while another domain holds 0000:01:00.0

risk: high; 4090 reset; 24G RAM leaves ~7G headroom

title: In-guest WinRM conformance probe from the same xbox-spec.json (taskbar, Start, Xbox, features, drivers, guest tools, components, users, GPU step result)

risk: low
